class.name: NNAngleToVector3XZSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores [Node3D] candidates by the signed horizontal (XZ-plane) angle between their forward direction and a vector.
class.description: Compares each [Node3D] candidate's forward direction (-Z) against [member angle_to_direction_vector] projected onto the horizontal XZ plane ([code]-180..180[/code] degrees). Use for grounded 3D AI where left/right heading matters and vertical pitch should be ignored. For full 3D unsigned angles, use [NNAngleToVector3SearchCriterion].

members.member: Reference direction projected onto the XZ plane and compared against each candidate's forward direction (-Z).
Maximum signed angle in degrees (up to [code]180.0[/code]). Maps to [code]1.0[/code] when scoring; angles above it are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
Minimum signed angle in degrees (down to [code]-180.0[/code]). Maps to [code]0.0[/code] when scoring; angles below it are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
